design.action_carrier_count_formula: 3 appearances * 3 action programs * 2 generation seeds = 18 independently self-generated carriers
design.prompt_count_formula: 3 appearances * 3 action carriers * 8 identity-bound arms = 72 prompts per seed/sigma
design.carrier_isolation: every (appearance,action_program,seed) owns one independently self-generated action carrier; no carrier or nontext state is shared across action programs
design.within_carrier_replay: all eight arms share the exact carrier nontext state, timestep, rotary state, sigma cell, and projection identity
design.caption_instantiation: each action/noop caption is rendered from that state's own actor/object/source/destination nouns; full captions may never be copied across appearances
design.same_action_across_appearance: action identity and canonical action embedding digest are constant across appearances while instantiated prompt text, appearance state, and independently generated carrier remain appearance-specific
design.neutral_caption_and_embedding: one byte-identical role-free neutral prompt and one identical neutral embedding digest across all states

cross_fit.phase_shuffle_scope: permute branch proposal phases only; every evaluation phase is byte-identical and remains at its original index

loao.same_action_prototype: permutation-invariant graph-signature mean of the two non-held reference appearances from the reference seed for exactly one action_id; raw spatial maps are never averaged across appearances
loao.cross_seed_rule: D_to_H uses seed D references and seed H held signature; H_to_D swaps those roles; both directions must pass
loao.held_cell_count_formula: 3 sigmas * 3 held appearances * 3 actions * 2 cross-seed directions = 54

proposal_and_graph.observed_death_definition: a neutral/UOT track is dead only after more than 2 consecutive subsequent blank evaluation phases have actually been observed
proposal_and_graph.right_censor_definition: an open track with at most 2 unavailable phases at the branch endpoint is right-censored and is not a death
proposal_and_graph.authoritative_track_identity: prompt-neutral visual correspondence followed by dustbin-augmented Sinkhorn matching
proposal_and_graph.carrier_coordinate_normalization: one common translation and robust scene scale per carrier graph; never per-track coordinate frames
proposal_and_graph.signature_section_normalization: node-worldline, edge-event-sequence, and temporal-ordering sections are independently L2 normalized before LOAO

dustbin_augmented_sinkhorn.algorithm: V6 mass-balanced augmented Sinkhorn with explicit source and target dustbins; no KL-relaxed UOT claim

correspondence_extra_gates.scope: prompt-neutral visual descriptor contrast followed by a frozen spatial prior; object identity correspondence is not scientifically claimed

tube_topology.contact_proxy: one-patch four-neighbor dilation overlap divided by union

action_specific_program_gates.reason: universal endpoint cosine is undefined for lift-return and closed orbit-return, so both paraphrase and reverse use frozen signed dynamics for the named program

transfer.paraphrase: same sign and min/max absolute-magnitude ratio >= 0.5
transfer.reverse: opposite sign and min/max absolute-magnitude ratio >= 0.5

lift_pause_return.metric: early and late common-frame vertical velocities plus signed order score late-minus-early
lift_pause_return.paraphrase: same early sign, late sign, and order-score sign; velocity-pair cosine >= 0.5
lift_pause_return.reverse: opposite early sign, late sign, and order-score sign; velocity-pair cosine <= -0.1

clockwise_orbit_return.metric: signed oriented winding area of the closed common-frame graph-centroid path
clockwise_orbit_return.paraphrase: same winding sign and min/max absolute-magnitude ratio >= 0.5
clockwise_orbit_return.reverse: opposite winding sign and min/max absolute-magnitude ratio >= 0.5

v6_control_matrix_difference.static_control_replacement: exact action-agnostic noop proposal must have zero raw proposal supports
v6_control_matrix_difference.source_swap_control_replacement: LOAO wrong-action prototypes and positive separation margin under strict held-appearance exclusion

independent_null.definition: separately forwarded null_a minus separately forwarded null_b; both are state-instantiated semantically equivalent no-op prompts with different wording

within_carrier_factorization.arm_residual: R_arm=Z(arm)-N for primary, paraphrase, reverse, lexical_placebo, and noop
within_carrier_factorization.neutral_usage: prompt-neutral anonymous correspondence descriptor only; neutral is not the residual center

frozen_base.observer_forward_formula: 3 appearances * 3 action carriers * 2 seeds * 3 sigma cells * 8 arms = 432
frozen_base.B0_forward_formula: 3 appearances * 3 action instructions * 2 seeds * 3 sigma cells = 54
frozen_base.trajectory_forward_formula: 3 appearances * 3 action carriers * 2 seeds * 40 UniPC steps * 2 guidance forwards = 1440
frozen_base.B0_pairing: one observer-absent B0 for every (appearance,action instruction,seed,sigma), paired to the corresponding observer-on primary replay
